'''Inner Curved Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. One end intersected with [[Kerner Plaza/Legends|Kerner Plaza]] and [[Outer Kerner Way]], and the other end became [[Dune Street/Legends|Dune Street]].

[[File:Mos_Eisley_spaceship.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Dowager Queen'' at Dune Street in Mos Eisley.]]

The wreckage of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']] was situated on the corner of this street and Dune Street.
